title: About DarGlobal
text:
# About DarGlobal
DarGlobal is an international luxury real-estate developer. Its Founder and Chief Executive Officer is Ziad El Chaar.
Brand message: 'Live All In' - homes, communities and destinations built with trusted global partners, positioned around integrity, design and long-term value for investors and second-home buyers.
DarGlobal is listed on the London Stock Exchange and the About page cites over 31 years of luxury development experience.
Its portfolio includes developments with iconic luxury brands, including Aston Martin and Lamborghini. The About page also lists its global sales offices and city projects.
The site offers investor relations information, online booking and a get-in-touch page.
